description: Territoires à Risque d’Inondation important (TRI BASSE-TERRE) - Gestion de crise (Bâtiments) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Sensitive institutions, infrastructure and facilities whose flooding may aggravate or complicate crisis management. These are buildings used for crisis management or sensitive buildings that may present evacuation difficulties and establishments receiving the public. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Territories at significant flood risk (TRI BASSE-TERRE) — Crisis management (Buildings)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Zones à risques naturelles, TRI, Directive inondation. The listing shows 2020-03-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
